meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织协作团队跑多轮调研,产出带引用、经质检的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要一份结论有据可查、经得起追问的深度调研报告。
copy.tagline_en: Run multi-round team research and get a cited, QA-checked report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a deep research report where every claim is cited and verified.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先拆解课题、组建研究小队并行搜集,再让成员互相辩论、用代码验证有争议的说法,最后交付每条结论都带引用或验证凭据的成品(如 PDF、DOCX)。
howto.when: 当你明确要求研究或深度调查,或说出 “ulw-research”、“ulw” 研究措辞、“ultradebate” 等字样时触发;普通提问和调试不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 把这个主题做到穷尽式调研
say.note: 会先给出格式方案并等你确认

say.text: ulw-research:对比这两套方案,结论都要有出处
say.note: 有争议的说法会被辩论并验证

say.text: 用 ulw-research 深挖这个问题,先互相辩一轮
say.note: 小队成员会交叉质疑后再交付

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scopes the topic, stands up a research team, fans out across sources, debates contested claims, proves them by running code, and delivers a report where every claim carries a citation or proof.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for research or a deep investigation, or use 'ulw-research' / any 'ulw' research wording or 'ultradebate' requests; ordinary questions do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to exhaustively research this topic
say_en.note: It first proposes format options and waits.

say_en.text: ulw-research: compare these two approaches, with sources for every claim
say_en.note: Contested claims get debated and verified.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on this; debate it before concluding
